title: AutoTrust JEV-27B-VL on vLLM (one 80 GB+ GPU)
slug_note: The card's serve.sh: vLLM with a decision endpoint on port 8000.

engine.config: vLLM via the repo's serve.sh / serve_decide.py; POST /v1/decide

requirements.notes: Card: about 52 GB of weights plus about 65 KB of KV per token; on an 80 GB GPU start with --max-model-len 131072.

steps.text: Send requests to http://localhost:8000/v1/decide (AutoTrust's own request shape; see the card).

caveats: Decision model: it answers typed questions with probabilities on /v1/systemone; it does not chat, so OpenCode and chat UIs cannot use it.
Not from TypeSafe (Jev's maker) despite the name.
Uses POST /v1/decide, not the Jev /v1/systemone shape.
#1 of 20 on the community Decision Index 0.3 vision board (69.82, 2026-10-07), per the card.

sources.note: card: serve.sh, memory notes, Decision Index board
